issue_context.title: Reusing Goroutines in Statistics Using Goroutine Pool
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, the statistics module does not efficiently reuse Goroutines, resulting in suboptimal performance. To improve resource utilization and enhance performance, we need to implement a Goroutine pool in the statistics module.

review_comments: Please add some comments to describe what this Pool is used for in `StatsHandle`.
